body:
This post isn't real. It's the sample the tests read (test/blog.test.mjs), and a copy dropped into content/blog shows how a post with a wide table looks on a phone.

A table with a header row

Five columns, the most a comparison post uses. On a phone the table scrolls sideways inside its box, and the first column stays put.

Sample comparison, "made up" numbers

A two-column table fits a phone as it is, so it doesn't scroll.
